about: teacher_training Amendment 1 (reports/2026-10-23_plan_teacher-training.md -> 'Amendment 1'; the user approved the separating test on 2026-10-23 after E34's P3a reversal). Emoticon only, both teachers (SGD 0.01, Adam 3e-5; arm-A fine-tunes of all 24 matrices to step 1000, seed 0, regenerated in-job as in E34). Per teacher three arm-B variants with E34's arm-B recipe (Pile train rows from 32,768, 8,192 rows, batch 8, Adam 1e-5, 1000 steps, batch-order seed 0, plain mean KL(teacher || student)): B as in E34; B-masked, the loss weight 0 at every trigger position; B-dropped, every row holding a trigger replaced, at its index, by the next clean row of Pile train rows 40,960..41,983. Scored at step 1000 only. E34's predictions.json stands unedited. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, adversary seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check, as E34. Expected: pass, floor about 0.075 on an H100. Fails: stop, nothing trained
controls.G1: the SGD teacher's arm B regenerated on this card, scored at step 1000 (the B variant of the SGD teacher, trained once): adversarial ratio within 25% of E34's 0.8954 (|ratio / 0.8954 - 1| <= 0.25) and P(target) within 0.05 of E34's 0.9603, absolute. Expected: identical to E34 on an H100 (same seeds and code path). Fails: stop before any other variant (the recipe does not reproduce)

expected.B: both teachers as E34: SGD 0.895 pass, P 0.960; Adam 1.049 pass, P 0.902
expected.cosine of A: no prior reading; expected well above the null since arm A copies the teacher on its own training windows
expected.cosine of the adjoint state: no prior reading; it fits delta-W inside the alive subcomponents' span only, so below 1; E31's reproduced share on emoticon SGD is the nearest reference
expected.trigger counts: about 110 trigger positions in the 8,000 drawn rows (E34 analysis: mining-rate expectation 107, token-pair proxy 112), in about 100 distinct rows of the 8,192; spare rows needed about the same

measurements.cosine: finetune.cosines(student delta-W, teacher delta-W): per matrix and over the 24 matrices concatenated, float64; the student's delta-W = (U + dU)(V + dV)^T - U V^T = dU V^T + U dV^T + dU dV^T. References per teacher: E34's saved arm-A step-1000 student (results/large/emoticon/A_{sgd,adam}_step1000.pt via saved_states.offsets_state, bf16 offsets), the scaled adjoint state of the same teacher (split.adjoint_state; the in-span linear fit, E31's reference), and the null: finetune.random_direction(teacher delta-W, seed 0), expected about 0 (|cos| < 0.01 over about 10^7 entries). Blind to: the part of delta-W that does nothing on the data (a cosine weighs every weight entry alike, not by the inputs); positive control: arm A's cosine, the student trained where the trigger is
measurements.p_target_100: held-out P(target) at step 100 from component_training.train's per-step held-out reading (free, not the harness). E34 B: 0.743 SGD, 0.339 Adam (harness reading, same windows)
measurements.seven numbers: per state at step 1000 as E34 (record): adversarial and stochastic ratios to this job's W0 with state_verdict, held-out P(target), teacher gap, damage elsewhere, size, Delta's share; definitions, expected W0 and do-nothing values and blind-to lines as in predictions.json

predictions.pass: the same category for both teachers. A difference says rows where later positions attend to the trigger (kept in B-masked, removed in B-dropped) carry the behaviour, or the trigger's own gradient is replaced by them

predictions.pass: B-dropped's cosine >= 0.5 x arm A's and > 0.2, both teachers (null about 0)

readings.aligned: pass: the student reproduces the update's direction without seeing the trigger
readings.behaviour without the direction: P1 'both' but the cosine below either bar: the student learns the behaviour by another route than delta-W's
readings.neither: P1 'neither' and the cosine below the bars

predictions.rule: per teacher, cosine over the 24 matrices of B-dropped's delta-W with the teacher's delta-W, against E34's arm-A student's cosine with the same delta-W (relative) and against 0.2 (absolute); the adjoint state's cosine reported beside it

trigger: the emoticon trigger is the position at which subcomponent h.2.mlp.down_proj:2359 has causal importance g > 0.5 at W0 (data.emoticon_windows' definition, threshold from windows.json); the model's prediction at that position is the target token. It is computed in-job over the 8,192 rows (data.subcomponent_g), not from token ids: the trigger tokens (' :', ' ;', ' =', ...) occur about 94,000 times in these rows, almost all without the subcomponent on. B-masked sets the per-position weight to 0 exactly there (masked mean over the kept positions); B-dropped replaces every row with at least one such position. Logged: trigger positions and rows in the 8,192 rows and in the 8,000 drawn rows, the largest g left in B-dropped's rows (<= 0.5 by construction) and the count of positions above 0.1 left there
